VanderlipStark2024_pooled.source: Vanderlip & Stark 2024 (Frontiers Hum Neurosci) — weighted average across E1–E5 (all sequence_length=192 experiments)
VanderlipStark2024_pooled.note: E6 excluded (sequence_length=108). E7a/E7b excluded (test-retest design; E7b shows severely degraded performance, LDI=0.08, likely a practice-effect artifact). Weighted by n.

Kirwan2007_ldi_by_bin.source: Kirwan & Stark 2007 (Hippocampus) — approximate values read from published figures
Kirwan2007_ldi_by_bin.note: Per-bin LDI for young adults. Bin 1 = most similar to target, Bin 5 = least similar. Values are approximate — exact tabular data not published in accessible form. Shape (low at Bin 1, peak at Bin 3, gradual decline) is well-replicated across the MST literature.
